inputs.commit_message: chore: publish current local main with workflow auth
inputs.shell_command: set -euo pipefail; repo=/home/hesham/gova; test "$(git -C "$repo" branch --show-current)" = main; git -C "$repo" fetch origin main; test -z "$(git -C "$repo" status --porcelain)"; auth=$(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | base64 -w0); git -C "$repo" -c http.extraheader="AUTHORIZATION: basic $auth" push origin HEAD:main
